basic_profile.bio: Based in Austin, Texas, I work as a freelance graphic designer, specializing in vector graphics. I spend my days juggling between client projects and indulging in my hobbies like gaming and biking. I'm particularly interested in strategy games and often jump into threads discussing game tactics. I'm usually online in the evenings after work and sometimes during lunch breaks. I'm single and enjoy exploring new technologies and DIY projects.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I am self-taught in graphic design, having started with Photoshop and later transitioned to Inkscape for vector work. I gained most of my knowledge through online tutorials, forums, and trial-and-error. I'm also a tech enthusiast, keeping up with the latest in gaming and digital tools.
